editorial.blurb: High Five Ramen is a basement-level ramen bar in Fulton Market with authentic Japanese counter seating, excellent service, and a surprisingly stellar beer and cocktail program.
editorial.insiderTip: With only 15-18 seats, make a reservation or arrive after 8pm to avoid 30+ minute waits; the staff will walk you through spice levels and drink pairings at the bar.
signatureDishes: Orange kabosu slush with rice gin
